read_only_allowlist._note: D-018 (2026-09-08) + Umesh 2026-09-24 (qa/feedback-inbox.md 16:33, 'T-126 adapter allowlist: allow krr dee'): evidence-gathering commands a checker already legitimately runs mid-check, beyond the three required gates above — none of these are part of the pass/fail gate itself. Each entry here may only operate within a self-created temp dir, or mutate-and-restore a local fixture under tests/fixtures; none may mutate bound source outside tests/fixtures, push, or reach the network (AT-560: the prior 'nothing here may write, push, delete or reach the network' phrasing was inaccurate for scripts/regression_proof.py, which mutates and restores a tracked fixture file). A command not covered by verify.commands or this list is CONTRACT_MISMATCH per domain-adapter.md's Security invariant.

commands.note: T-126 done_check asserts this literal entry exists; live-browser proof of the explorer crawl (D-024) against the local fixture site only — read-only, no live product touched
mirrors the explorer's proof script for the regression suite; read-only against the local fixture site (tests/fixtures/regression_site/)
reads container metadata (e.g. StartedAt for the AT-085 live-run staleness guard); never starts, stops or mutates a container
reads one commit/blob to confirm what a manifest's cited SHA actually contains

content-hash comparison of an evidence file, Windows equivalent of md5sum

checker-authored one-off probe scripts, scoped to the project's scratch dir (never the repo root); each is read-only toward the bound tree by the capability-coverage falsification rule (maker/SKILL.md), which requires perturbation to happen in a throwaway copy outside it

done._note: No production deploy exists for this project yet. Done = slot-1 verify green + the unit's own contract criteria judged PASS by /checker. When a deployable surface appears, this becomes kind=deploy with a confirm_url.

parallel.note: Headed browser tests must be serialized (one visible Chromium at a time); the full pytest suite (about 31 minutes) has been killed by memory pressure on this 24 GB machine, so code slots also shrink with free RAM. The 6c sharded full suite holds the machine-wide suite lock and is not counted here.

_notes.parallel: code: test/build slots, at most 4 and at most floor((free GB - 1.5) / 2); browser: one headed browser at a time, 1.1 GB per browser (measured in D:/hei-sweep on this machine, not re-measured here). No mongo_read, mongo_write or search lane: this project has no Mongo and no single-IP search run.
_notes.quick_lane: Off. lane.enabled is deliberately absent; only the owner sets it. Before it is ever enabled, lane.public_api, lane.schema, lane.shared and lane.quick_lane_exclude must be written for src/autotester (redact, secrets, consent, approval, browser, schema, providers) or every small diff outside the built-in keyword list becomes eligible.
